title:
Epic that handles the creation of a new model scenario.

Called from the "Create Scenario" modal, this epic will:
- Create the {@link ReliabilityOrchestrator.ModelScenarioProcess.Spec} for the scenario.
- Start the scenario job.
- Redirect to the scenario details page.

**NOTE**: This epic does not expect an `action.payload`.
